system.notes:
Strice Foods' "low-cost" corporate system (QE p.34). Modelled as one SR2E host at a representative Security Code Orange-4 (the CPU tier). The SR1 system map's per-node color-codes drive MANUAL operation TNs / success thresholds the GM applies as the decker moves between nodes:

  • SAN (gateway, #2206 / 312-1752) — Red-5, Access 5: a tougher initial Access/Logon test than the host baseline.
  • SPU-1 — Orange-3: Trace-and-Dump 3 IC.
  • CPU — Orange-4: Barrier 3 + Tar Pit 4 IC.
  • DS-1 — Orange-3, Barrier 4: purchase orders — the MegaMedia deal (1,280,000¥ for Euphoria's three appearances) and Knight Errant expenditures. 4 files × 70 Mp = 28,000¥ fenced.
  • DS-2 — Orange-5, Scramble 3: Accounts Receivable. 3 files × 80 Mp = 60,000¥.
  • DS-3 — Green-3: Seattle retailer/distributor list. 2 files × 40 Mp = 4,000¥.

Trigger: an external alert shuts the whole system down within two minutes; any Trace result prints at Burroughs' terminal, and he calls Lone Star (immediately if he's in-office by day, otherwise next morning). No vital clues live here — the run is for paydata and the MegaMedia/Craft trail. Defending IC below link to this host via system.hostUuid.
